text:
Nora (Growth): Quick thread to finalize copy + routing for the tri-mode launch. Need: 1 launch post, 3 landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), webinar slate, and inbound routing matrix. Link to draft: https://tiny.redwood/tri-mode-draft :spiral_calendar:
Diego (PMM): Solid. Core narrative: explain why serving matters (latency/cost/reliability) then map each mode to a single promise. Keep tone developer-first, examples over hyperbole.
Sam (Content): Draft hero lines: Hosted: "Launch fast, iterate quickly." Dedicated: "Throughput you can commit to." Private: "Inference inside your network." Subheads will call out the gating signal (speed / predictability / compliance).
Asha (Design): I'll produce three hero comps + one shared benchmark module. Per legal: don't publish raw internal benchmarks on public pages 1, we'll use "verified performance profiles" as teaser and gate the full kit.
Vik (Sales Ops): Routing rules: Hosted CTA -> product nurture (no AE); Dedicated CTA -> AE queue "Enterprise-Reserved"; Private CTA -> security screening form then AE. Add hidden CTA param `mode_hint` to capture clicks for routing fallback.
Sam (Content): CTA microcopy: Hosted: "Start free 1 no card"; Dedicated: "Reserve capacity 1 talk to sales"; Private: "Request private eval 1 security first". Include a small line under hero linking to webinar + gated benchmark kit.
Diego (PMM): Webinar plan: 40m demo + benchmark walk-through, 20m Q&A. Ask registrants to pick mode_interest and monthly_tokens_bucket. Use the gated kit as post-webinar download to capture intent.
auto-bot: Note: publishing webinar page will create HubSpot campaign id=tri_mode_launch_2026 and append utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch to CTA links. Also auto-create form fields: mode_interest, monthly_tokens_bucket, primary_use_case.
Vik (Sales Ops): After copy freeze I'll map CTA IDs to HubSpot workflows. SLA: AE follow-up for Dedicated/Private leads within 24h. Hosted leads go through product activation emails.
Nora (Growth): A/B plan: test hero headline (speed vs cost predictability) on Hosted and Dedicated for 10 days. Primary signals = webinar signups + demo clicks. Timeline: copy freeze tomorrow 10am PT, designs by 5pm, QA Wed, soft launch Thurs EOD. I'll post final runbook here after freeze. :white_check_mark:
